remarks:
Country Estate with Views and Ponds
The Bo Farm is located in the heart of Allegany County, NY, in Scio. Rolling hills and vast pastures grace the property, offering a highland-like topography that is simply breathtaking. The farm shines with a highland-like experience and delivering vista views that are simply breathtaking. The main entrance and approach to the property is spectacular, with white fences and landscaped trees leading you to the farmhouse and the rolling hills and fields. Two ponds are located on the farm, each stocked with different species of fish. A bass pond, a catfish pond The Knights Creek stream also winds through the south edge of the property, close to the farmhouse, for additional fun and recreation. The farmhouse is the jewel of the property. The entire home has been renovated and expanded in 2007 with east and west facing covered porches, five bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a gourmet kitchen with a high-end commercial-grade appointments. The centerpiece of the kitchen is a 10 x 6 Corian counter island and 38 running feet of surrounding countertop. There are wide-plank hardwood floors throughout the house that lead through a large dining room and a huge great room, with a main-floor laundry and office. Upstairs is the owner's suite and four more large bedrooms with vaulted ceilings and beautiful views from each window of the farm in all directions. There is also a huge bonus loft area that has been improved to a children's bedroom and playroom. The basement has a complete canning center for preparing and preserving the bounties from the garden. The barn is a massive two-story, 9600 sq ft building, large enough for all and any farm equipment. Concrete floors, electricity, water, a bathroom, and a fully equipped meat/deer processing center with a walk-in cooler are all part of this well-planned outbuilding. 
This farm is a spectacular blend of elements that would make it a wonderful residence, a retreat, an Airbnb business, a corporate property, or a place to call home and be your dream location in the country.
